tools.name: search_cigars
tools.description:
Search premium cigar lines in the Neptune Cigars / Cigar Scanner catalog.

All filters optional. strength: Mild | Mild-Medium | Medium | Medium-Full | Full.
origin examples: Nicaragua, Dominican Republic, Honduras, USA.
wrapper examples: Connecticut, Maduro, Habano, Corojo, Nicaraguan.
max_box_price

tools.name: get_cigar_line
tools.description:
Full details for one cigar line, by line_id (from search_cigars) or name.

Returns taste profile (strength/wrapper/binder/filler/origin), community
rating breakdown incl. draw/burn/aroma/taste sub-ratings, price range, and
description from the Cigar Scanner knowledge base.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search buyable products (SKUs) on neptunecigar.com by name.

Returns live sellable items — exact vitola/packaging (single, 5-pack,
box) — with current price, stock availability, and a direct product URL.
Use search_cigars first to pick a line, then this to find what's in stock.

tools.name: check_shipping
tools.description:
Check whether Neptune Cigars can ship premium cigars to a US state.

Accepts a state name or 2-letter code. Returns the DTC shipping posture,
age/ID delivery rules, and tax notes for that state. Neptune ships from
Florida; all deliveries require an adult (21+) recipient.

tools.name: similar_cigars
tools.description:
Cigar lines similar to a given line — for 'if you like X, try Y'.

Uses Cigar Scanner's similarity data plus profile matching
(same strength + origin, comparable rating) as fallback.
